readout_other: fluorescent CSF tracer influx and clearance imaging; ELISA of Abeta in deep cervical lymph nodes; Abeta and Iba1 immunohistochemistry; novel object recognition; Morris water maze; Piezo1 qPCR and western blot
direction_notes: LITFUS increased CSF tracer influx and hippocampal solute clearance, reduced Abeta deposition and Iba1 immunoreactivity and improved memory in 5xFAD mice; neuronal excitation or inhibition not assessed.
safety_notes: Evans blue and sodium fluorescein assays showed no BBB disruption and H&E staining showed no histological injury; a LITFUS plus microbubble group served as BBB-opening positive control.

WT control and 5xFAD sham mice underwent the same anesthesia, stereotaxic fixation, gel coupling, transducer placement, and handling procedures, except that no ultrasound was delivered. After each session, mice were placed in a temperaturecontrolled recovery chamber and monitored until full recovery of ambulation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: Mice were randomly assigned to three groups using a computer-generated randomization sequence: wild-type (WT) control, 5xFAD sham, and 5xFAD+LITFUS. Mice were anesthetized with an intraperitoneal injection of ketamine/ xylazine (70 mg/kg ketamine and 10 mg/kg xylazine) and secured in a stereotaxic frame after scalp preparation. Body temperature was maintained at 37 °C using a feedback-controlled heating pad, and respiratory rate was monitored throughout the procedure. A single-element focused ultrasound transducer (diameter, 12 mm; focal length, 10.5mm; Nanjing Huiyang Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., China) was coupled to the skull with ultrasound gel and aligned stereotaxically to target the bilateral hippocampal region. Ultrasound stimulation parameters were selected based on a previously optimized protocol: fundamental frequency, 1.04 MHz; pulse duration, 500 μs; pulse repetition period, 1 ms; pulse repetition frequency, 1000 Hz; sonication duration, 300 ms; inter-train interval, 3s; spatial-peak pulse-average intensity (Isppa), 39mW/cm<sup>2</sup>;
